name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A grey stand-in for content on its way, with a fixed size so nothing moves when the real content arrives; pulses slowly and stands still under reduced motion. Also SkeletonText for lines of text.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the block. A number is pixels; a string is any CSS length ("100%", "12rem"). Default "100%".

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the block, the same units. Default 16.

props.name: circle
props.description: A circle of the given `width` (and the same height), for avatars.

a11y.text: Every block is aria-hidden, so a screen reader hears nothing from it. The region around it (loading-region) says that something is loading; used alone, give the container aria-busy and a role="status" line.
The slow pulse is motion-safe only: under reduced motion the block is a flat grey, with no shimmer and no movement. Sizes are fixed, so the swap to real content moves nothing.
